facts.business: Zenlabs Ethica Limited was formerly registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) but had its registration cancelled by the RBI on November 7, 2025, and is now realigning its business model after disposing of investments and loans inconsistent with permitted operations.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment including capital advances

auditor.name: M/s. N Kumar Chhabra & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Balance confirmations not received for trade receivables, trade payables, advances, and other assets/liabilities, subject to reconciliation. 2) Company's NBFC registration cancelled by RBI on November 7, 2025; investments and loans written off, with exceptional item impact of Rs 207.81 Lakhs.

key_risks: Balance confirmations not received for trade receivables, trade payables, advances, and other financial/non-financial assets and liabilities, subject to reconciliation
Company's NBFC registration cancelled by RBI on November 7, 2025; no longer permitted to carry on NBFC activities
Foreign currency risk on trade receivables (Rs 3.11 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026)
